summary: Learn to secure and manage grants effectively, enhance fundraising strategies, and maximize impact with our Grant Management and Fundraising Training Course.
lede: Grant management training helps nonprofit, NGO, and public-sector professionals plan funding proposals and oversee grants from donor research through close-out. It covers donor mapping, proposal design using the Theory of Change and Logical Framework Approach, grant budgeting, compliance monitoring, and impact reporting. Participants practice mapping a grant lifecycle, preparing a budget justification, and creating donor progress reports.
audienceIntro: This program is essential for professionals responsible for the financial health and operational integrity of non-profit organizations, NGOs, and public sector entities.
modules: The Global Funding Landscape and Grant Lifecycle
Strategic Donor Mapping and Prospect Research
Designing High-Impact Proposals using Theory of Change
Budgeting and Financial Management for Grants
Digital Fundraising and Diversified Revenue Streams
Grant Compliance, Reporting, and Audit Readiness
prerequisites: Participants should have a basic understanding of project management principles and at least one year of experience working in a non-profit, NGO, or public sector environment. No prior experience with specific grant management software is required, but familiarity with Microsoft Excel for budgeting is highly recommended.
topics: Financial management for NGOs & donor-funded projects
